verdict.rationale: A probe confirms NVIDIA's developer portal, which hosts the CUDA Toolkit docs for this GPU, serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200) that an agent can be pointed at. However, it is a portal-wide index rather than RTX 5090-specific, the markdown version of the CUDA Toolkit page returns 404, and no OpenAPI spec exists. Missing for 10: per-page markdown or agent-oriented docs, product-specific llms.txt content, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
